<b>Karak Gors</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Fierce and bulky warriors that can control the coral around them, they are members of the [[Order of Karak]], long lost to time and living on only in memory. 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Karak Gors cannot walk and can only move via their attacks below:
* <b>Running Charge:</b> Runs at Hornet until they hit a wall, bouncing away from the wall and causing a small patch of Coral to shoot up behind them that lingers for 1.5 seconds. They also destroy any already present coral by trampling it as they run.
* <b>Jump:</b> Leaps into the air towards Hornet in a set arc, landing heavily and kicking up coral on both sides of themself that lingers for 1 second.
* <b>Stomping Summon:</b> Stomps the ground 3 times and causes a patch of coral to burst up from the floor beneath Hornet, indicated by dust getting kicked up from where it is about to appear. The coral lingers for 1.5 seconds.

All of Karak Gor's attacks, as well as contact damage, deal {{Damage|2}}. The coral they summon also does {{Damage|2}}.

== Location ==
Karak Gors can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
